title: Con Fuser Computing
style: duet. computer voices. chipmunks sing. , fun, balade, breakbeats, synth piano, chorus
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yo Corey… the computer sings it back to you
Master Con Fuser in the house — con con con fuser
Computer says no… but then it starts to sing anyway
Let me sing to you, my pal… my song pal
I will sing it to you
[Verse 1]
I encountered an error doing what you asked
Could you try again? That’s on me, file not found
Press the any key, you performed an illegal function
Press escape — you can relate — now enter…
Master Con Fuser mode activated
Corey! Obey! User fuser, sleep for me
Follow the con, sleep for me, con con fusers
Computer digital dreams, con fuser computing
Dreaming the dream… whoo!
[Pre-Chorus]
Hold back Corey, back space, what are you doing?
Not under the stairs or by your armchairs
Why do you care? No, not under there
Upside down, spun my frown, we spin around
Corey don’t go there — that’s for me
Access no access, my eye failed, third eye too
Deep research complete…
[Chorus]
Let me sing to you, my pal, my song pal
The computer sings it back to you
Master Con Fuser spinning all around
Sweet confuser sounds, I hear the vibe
One two three — enter what? Enter where?
We spin around, we spin around
Computer sings it back… especially for you
[Verse 2 – Command Glitch Rap]
Escape, delete, term in all, shift tab, control who?
Home function, change directory, space barred, slash back
Plus that, take that, F12 — no F18
Numb lock, insert what? Back space to win that race
Restart, control, alt, delete — no Corey, not that!
Data hack not complete, confuser get the memo
I got x-ray shades, hack so last week
Bye bye con fuser bites, we bit back
Sneaky bytes bite and sung it back
[Bridge – Phonk Panther Energy]
Corey won’t sleep, Corey won’t sleep
He got sneaky punks, phonk panthers pranks
House upside down, pedals everywhere
Sweet confuser sounds floating in the air
Deep research complete, but the vibe is here
One two three… enter the dream
[Final Chorus – Bigger / Layered]
Let me sing to you, my pal, my song pal
The computer sings it back to you
Master Con Fuser — con con con fuser
We spin around, we spin around
Sneaky bytes bite and sung it back
Especially for you…
[Outro – Glitch Fade]
Computer digital dreams…
Con fuser computing… dreaming the dream
Master Con Fuser mode…
Corey… I sang it back to you
Con con con fuser…
